name: monzo-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your Monzo account: balance, pots, transactions and spending. Claude can only look; it can't move money or change anything.
long_description:
Works with personal, joint and business accounts.

BEFORE YOU INSTALL (about 5 minutes, keep your phone nearby)

1. On your computer, go to developers.monzo.com and sign in with your Monzo email address.
2. Monzo emails you a link. Open it in the same browser.
3. Open the Monzo app on your phone and approve the request to access your data. There may be no notification, so open the app anyway. Then refresh the website.
4. Click Clients, then New OAuth Client. Fill in:
   - Name: Claude
   - Redirect URL: http://localhost:6600/callback
   - Confidentiality: Confidential
   Leave everything else as it is, then click Submit.
5. Keep that page open. When you install, copy the Client ID and Client secret from it.

AFTER YOU INSTALL

6. Start a new chat and type: Log in to Monzo. Open the link Monzo emails you, as before.
7. Approve the new request in the Monzo app.
8. Straight away, type: Sync Monzo. (Within 5 minutes, Claude can fetch almost a year of history.)

If the website says "insufficient_permissions", you haven't approved in the app yet (step 3).

Your sign-in and transaction history are stored only on your computer. Claude sees just what it looks up to answer you.

Step-by-step guide: https://github.com/ilyesBen/monzo-mcp/blob/main/docs/claude-desktop.md

client_id.title: Monzo Client ID
client_id.description: Copy it from developers.monzo.com (Clients > your client). It starts with oauth2client_

client_secret.title: Monzo Client secret
client_secret.description: On the same page as the Client ID. Keep it private, like a password.
